title: tanacetum alpinum var. cuneatum
intro: Tanacetum alpinum var. cuneatum, commonly known as Alpine Tansy, is a perennial plant in the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to relieve anxiety and insomnia, and is often used as a natural remedy to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Tansy include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as camphor, borneol, and borneol acetate. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of Tanacetum alpinum var. cuneatum.
